demo_must_show: OAuth consent flow for Locality with all visible requested permissions expanded and readable.
Mounting a Google Docs workspace folder and showing Locality enumerating Drive folders and Google Docs files under that folder.
Opening a pulled Google Doc in Locality to show Drive metadata and Google Docs body content are read.
Editing an existing Google Doc body from Locality and showing the changed content in the user's Google Docs account.
Renaming and, if exposed in the recorded workflow, moving a Google Doc from Locality and showing the Drive title or parent-folder change in the user's Google Drive account.
Creating a new Google Doc from Locality and showing the new document and body content in the user's Google Drive or Google Docs account.
Archiving or deleting a Google Doc from Locality and showing the file moved to Google Drive Trash if that user-facing workflow is enabled in the recorded app.
least_privilege_notes: documents is required because Locality reads Google Docs body content and applies body edits through the Google Docs API.
drive.file is required because Locality creates Google Docs and mutates app-created or explicitly granted Drive files for rename, move, and trash workflows.

drive.metadata.readonly is required because Locality discovers the workspace folder, lists child folders and Docs files, and records Drive metadata such as names, parents, modified time, versions, and trash state.
drive.metadata is not requested because writable Drive metadata access beyond app-created or explicitly granted files is not needed; app-file writes are covered by drive.file.
Full Drive, Drive readonly, and Docs readonly scopes are not requested by the runtime OAuth profile and must not be submitted for Google Docs verification.
